sourceOccurrences.note: 6HJ9 expands finite mixed and square moments and full extended moments by joint connections. Pointwise identities require no countability; the probabilistic statements retain countable vertices. The source uses the Bernoulli law, while the same indicator/Tonelli proof given here applies to any configuration law. NEM5 preserves cofinality over all finite subsets and the supremum conclusion without assuming an ordered index. Union coverage alone and arbitrary sequence convergence are expressly excluded.
